programs.title: Fox Sports Africa Boxing - South Africa, 28.07.2022
programs.desc: S18E07 ESPN Africa Boxing brings boxing fans a series of knockout events throughout the year. Fighters from all over the African continent are represented on the roster: Each event has 4 regular fights (4 to 8 rounds) and 2 WBA title fights (12 rounds). ESPN serves as the home of boxing in Africa and guarantees superb production quality as it promotes and produces ESPN Africa Boxing events throughout the African continent.

programs.title: Lux Fighting League - Mexico City, Mexico 19.05.2023
programs.desc: S33E24 LUX FIGHTING LEAGUE is the most exclusive MMA league in Latin America. In an environment of luxury, LUX provides a great stage for rising prospects which will deliver the most exciting and full of power fights. Interesting detail is that LUX cooperates closely with UFC, sharing fighters and promoting the LUX brand.
